ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)
test_cases_present: partial - the spec defines functional commands, register fields, state machine transitions, and timing tables that map directly to compliance test scenarios; SD Card Association maintains a separate formal compliance test plan that is out of scope of this simplified physical layer document.
derived_compliance_test_categories: CMD0 GO_IDLE_STATE — any state → Idle; RCA cleared to 0x0000.
CMD8 SEND_IF_COND v2.0+ voltage handshake — card echoes check pattern and accepted voltage in R7; v1.x card returns no response (illegal command).
ACMD41 SD_SEND_OP_COND initialization loop with HCS bit — card busy bit until init complete; OCR.CCS reports SDSC vs SDHC/SDXC.
ACMD41 with S18R=1 — card sets OCR.S18A=1 if it supports 1.8 V signaling.
CMD2 ALL_SEND_CID — card publishes its 128-bit CID in R2.
CMD3 SEND_RELATIVE_ADDR — card publishes new RCA in R6; card transitions to Stand-by.
CMD9 SEND_CSD — card returns 128-bit CSD in R2; verify CSD_STRUCTURE matches capacity (00b SDSC / 01b SDHC/SDXC).
CMD7 SELECT_CARD with matching RCA — Stby → Tran.
CMD7 with non-matching RCA from Tran/Prg/Data states — card deselected (Tran→Stby, Prg→Dis).
CMD16 SET_BLOCKLEN — SDSC accepts 1..2048; SDHC/SDXC fixed at 512.
CMD17 READ_SINGLE_BLOCK — Tran → Sending-data; DAT block + CRC16; back to Tran.
CMD18 READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCK — continuous read until CMD12 (or CMD23-defined count).
CMD24 WRITE_BLOCK — Tran → Receive-data → Programming → Tran; verify Data Response Token = 010 (accept).
CMD25 WRITE_MULTIPLE_BLOCK — multi-block write until CMD12.
CMD23 SET_BLOCK_COUNT pre-defining block count for CMD18/CMD25 (no CMD12 needed).
CMD12 STOP_TRANSMISSION — gracefully stops multi-block read/write.
CMD13 SEND_STATUS — read R1 / CSR; allowed during Programming.
CMD55 + ACMD6 SET_BUS_WIDTH — switch from 1-bit to 4-bit DAT mode.
CMD55 + ACMD13 SD_STATUS — read 512-bit SD Status on DAT.
CMD55 + ACMD51 SEND_SCR — read 64-bit SCR on DAT.
CMD6 SWITCH_FUNC — query (Mode 0) and set (Mode 1) High Speed / UHS-I bus speed mode.
CMD11 VOLTAGE_SWITCH — UHS-I 1.8 V transition; card pulls CMD/DAT LOW then HIGH after voltage settle.
CMD19 SEND_TUNING_BLOCK — UHS-I sampling-point calibration; card transmits the standard tuning pattern on DAT.
CMD32/CMD33/CMD38 ERASE — block-range erase; verify DAT0 busy until complete; ACMD22 reports number of successfully written blocks.
CMD42 LOCK_UNLOCK — set/clear password, lock/unlock, forced erase.
CMD CRC7 fault injection — bad CRC7; card ignores; host detects no response.
DAT CRC16 fault injection on write — card returns Data Response Token = 101 (CRC error).
Hot insertion — card detect transition; host waits VDD ramp + 1 ms + 74 CLK + CMD0.
Hot removal during programming — host detects via card-detect and aborts; flush buffers.
Write Protect mechanical switch — host detects WP; CMD24 returns CSR.WP_VIOLATION.
OUT_OF_RANGE / ADDRESS_ERROR — issue read/write past capacity; verify CSR error bits in R1.
ILLEGAL_COMMAND — issue command not legal in current state; verify CSR.ILLEGAL_COMMAND.
SPI mode entry — CS LOW during CMD0; verify card responds only on DO; CRC optional via CMD59.
